test_title: PYST 128: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 25 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Ali is sitting third to the right of Naeem. Syed is sitting second to the left of Ali. Sara is the immediate neighbour of Ali and Syed. Shenaz is second to the right of Ali. David is sitting third to the right of Syed. Who is sitting between Sara and David?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information is as:

1. Ali is sitting third to the right of Naeem and Syed is sitting second to the left of Ali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/786fa25df4b675f9741eceafb48992906f567bdf65809949935672a48d4f441a.png] 

2. Sara is the immediate neighbour of Ali and Syed and Shenaz is second to the right of Ali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/306cc1a287611a9bf58300b5ce1947d26b5eb1ed222c70b138661bba2164f7f0.png] 

3. David is sitting third to the right of Syed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a074cabfb54a5c8103c23e5ef129098a99e06ddeb60e7cee5c7a5ccd17b4ab5.png] 

Here, **Ali **is sitting between Sara and David.

Hence, the correct answer is "Ali".
